source(output(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT ResultSet =  CAST(CONCAT(UNIQUE_MEMBER_IDENTIFIER,\'|\',CLAIM_NUMBER,\'|\',CLAIM_LINE,\'|\',DIAGNOSIS_1,\'|\',DIAGNOSIS_2,\'|\',DIAGNOSIS_3,\'|\',DIAGNOSIS_4,\'|\' 						   ,DIAGNOSIS_5,\'|\',DIAGNOSIS_6,\'|\',DIAGNOSIS_7,\'|\',DIAGNOSIS_8,\'|\',DIAGNOSIS_9,\'|\',DIAGNOSIS_10,\'|\',DIAGNOSIS_11,\'|\',DIAGNOSIS_12,\'|\',DIAGNOSIS_13 						   ,\'|\',DIAGNOSIS_14,\'|\',DIAGNOSIS_15,\'|\',DIAGNOSIS_16,\'|\',DIAGNOSIS_17,\'|\',DIAGNOSIS_18,\'|\',DIAGNOSIS_19,\'|\',DIAGNOSIS_20,\'|\',DIAGNOSIS_21 						   ,\'|\',DIAGNOSIS_22,\'|\',DIAGNOSIS_23,\'|\',DIAGNOSIS_24,\'|\',DIAGNOSIS_25,\'|\',PROCEDURE_CODE_1,\'|\',MODIFIER_1,\'|\',PROCEDURE_CODE_2,\'|\',MODIFIER_2 						   ,\'|\',PROCEDURE_CODE_3,\'|\',MODIFIER_3,\'|\',PROCEDURE_CODE_4,\'|\',MODIFIER_4,\'|\',PROCEDURE_CODE_5,\'|\',MODIFIER_5,\'|\',PROCEDURE_CODE_6,\'|\',MODIFIER_6 						   ,\'|\',PROCEDURE_CODE_7,\'|\',MODIFIER_7,\'|\',PROCEDURE_CODE_8,\'|\',MODIFIER_8,\'|\',PROCEDURE_CODE_9,\'|\',MODIFIER_9,\'|\',PROCEDURE_CODE_10,\'|\',MODIFIER_10) AS VARCHAR(MAX)) 		FROM EXTRACT.MINDOULA_STAGE_MEDCLMS_DIAG_PROCCODES WHERE (GRGR_CK = ? OR ROW_INDICATOR = \'HEADER\') 		GROUP BY UNIQUE_MEMBER_IDENTIFIER,CLAIM_NUMBER,CLAIM_LINE,DIAGNOSIS_1,DIAGNOSIS_2,DIAGNOSIS_3,DIAGNOSIS_4,DIAGNOSIS_5,DIAGNOSIS_6,DIAGNOSIS_7,DIAGNOSIS_8,DIAGNOSIS_9,DIAGNOSIS_10,DIAGNOSIS_11,DIAGNOSIS_12,DIAGNOSIS_13 				 ,DIAGNOSIS_14,DIAGNOSIS_15,DIAGNOSIS_16,DIAGNOSIS_17,DIAGNOSIS_18,DIAGNOSIS_19,DIAGNOSIS_20,DIAGNOSIS_21 				 ,DIAGNOSIS_22,DIAGNOSIS_23,DIAGNOSIS_24,DIAGNOSIS_25,PROCEDURE_CODE_1,MODIFIER_1,PROCEDURE_CODE_2,MODIFIER_2 				 ,PROCEDURE_CODE_3,MODIFIER_3,PROCEDURE_CODE_4,MODIFIER_4,PROCEDURE_CODE_5,MODIFIER_5,PROCEDURE_CODE_6,MODIFIER_6 				 ,PROCEDURE_CODE_7,MODIFIER_7,PROCEDURE_CODE_8,MODIFIER_8,PROCEDURE_CODE_9,MODIFIER_9,PROCEDURE_CODE_10,MODIFIER_10,ROW_INDICATOR 		ORDER BY ROW_INDICATOR DESC',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> GetDiagnosisandProcedureCodeData

		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
